setup.effects: Default: prepare loopback configuration and migrate local D1. Explicit --remote: validate production inputs, find or create the exactly named D1 and write a private target configuration without replacing owner values; deployment remains separate.

deploy.effects: Validate explicit worker/database/config, run full verify, build target, apply ordered remote migrations, install supplied secrets via stdin and upload the Worker. Does not claim live health or inbox delivery.

verify.effects: Local type, unit, isolated Worker/D1, capacity, current-data round-trip/refusal, migration, manifest, boundary, build and contract coverage gates. No deployment or live provider effects.

export.effects: Read-only consistent snapshot of an explicit local SQLite/D1 source into a new private archive; no provider calls or effects.

import.effects: Fully validates the private archive and restores only into an exclusively created new local SQLite/D1 database; preserves migrations and effect/auth state, never replaces existing files or starts providers.

authentication.deployment: Owner-selected Cloudflare account and Wrangler authentication; remote operations require explicit worker, database and configuration target.
authentication.operators: Maintained Base one-time bootstrap with SETUP_TOKEN, read-only link confirmation and single-use POST, opaque native sessions; loopback Base mail outbox only for synthetic development.

health.semantics: Configured Worker/D1 dependency health and build identity; does not prove provider delivery or remote acceptance.
